notes: 50 groups from parts 21-25 produced 66 rows. Merged groups (one row each): Remedy Robotics = 'remedy robotics' + 'expats remote surgery medtech' + '16d3590141c8'; Phononic debt = 'trinity capital provides' + 'trinity capital commits 100'; Daylight = 'daylight' + 'as'; Sparxity = 'dresdens sparxity hits 90m' + 'dresden based sparxity'; Project Omega = 'project omega' + 'newport clean tech and defense'; Oyster Therapeutics (ex-Kesmalea) = 'oyster therapeutics' + 'kesmalea therapeutics'; Spines = 'boynton beach book publishing' + 'e6d141cb9c40', emitted as two rows because the $64M package is a $29M Series A-1 plus a $35M debt facility. Group 'financial' held two unrelated stories (DI round, Focus Financial acquisition of ML Management Partners) and yields two rows. Round-ups expanded: FourWeekMBA weekly AI $100M+ list (12 rows, read via lookup; these will overlap rows from other parts; HQ for Mercor, Path Robotics, Nominal, LangChain, Blue J Legal, Rox, Agile Robots city comes from general knowledge, not the article; Torus, UFORCE and Onodrim are marked AI only because the list files them as AI rounds); ETBFSI Indian fintech October round-up (6 rows; the rounds closed in October 2026 and exact dates are not given, so announced_date is the article date 2026-11-11); AI Insider China physical AI round-up (3 rows; UniX AI 'Pre-A' mapped to Series A, angel rounds mapped to Seed, TensorWorld angel and angel-plus rounds combined because only a joint figure is given); Mercom solar round-up (5 rows incl. two acquisitions). Sparxity: the Series A size is not broken out ($90M / EUR 80M is cumulative funding), so amount_usd is null. Alta: row is the $47.5M Series A; $80M is total funding incl. an earlier $32.5M seed. Kindo: row is the $30M raise; $57.6M is total raised. Edelbyte: single $70M row for the combined seed and Series A (reports of a $25M/$45M split are inconsistent); US under the dual-HQ rule. Seawolf: Versant led the seed tranche only. Tiberius Aerospace HQ is uncertain (Newport Beach, CA per Caplight and job listings; London per another directory) and its date is the earliest article (Dealroom, Nov 13; wider coverage Nov 17). Clara HQ taken as Sao Paulo (not stated in the release; older coverage says Mexico City); a $40M General Catalyst CVF facility renewal announced with it has no separate row. The Instagram Indian weekly round-up names no companies and is one not-funding row. Lookups used: 24 of 25 (web searches and fetches for DI, Engitist x2, Sparxity, Tiberius x4, Reflect Orbital x2, Polymaker, Clara x2, Spines x2, Fortsense, VectorY, Edelbyte, Good Bricks, FourWeekMBA x3, Project Omega AI check, San Lorenzo). Not found by lookup: Polymaker round details (HQ CN from general knowledge), VectorY round type, Engitist round details (HQ Shanghai from CB Insights), Fortsense round details (Shenzhen from prior coverage), DI HQ.
